item.title: Artifact uploads or downloads during a pipeline run may be slow or fail to process

item.title: Availability Degradation in Central US
item.dc:creator: Merlyn Oppenheim (Azure DevOps)
item.description:
Final update
Merlyn Oppenheim, 9/29/2026 7:29:28 PM

The root cause of this issue was memory exhaustion on the application servers. We collected a live memory dump during the incident and determined that the issue is triggered by a specific data pattern that exposes a product defect, resulting in excessive memory consumption. Our engineers have identified the underlying bug and are working on a fix to prevent this condition from occurring in the future.
item.content:encoded:
